sentences.text:
Through: SI Naib Singh, PP HAri   Mr. Aakash Gupta & Mr. Kawaljit   Adv. for R-2 (thru VC  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 17.02.2023
1. Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.

1. This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No. 546/2012 PS Hari Nagar under sections 406/498A/34 I.P.C on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide settlement deed dated 19th December, 2022 which is on record of this Court.
2. Both the petitioner and respondent no.2-complainant are present in the Court and have been duly identified by their respective counsels as well as the IO.
It is however informed by the learned counsel for the parties that the first motion for divorce by mutual consent has already been concluded and the parties shall shortly apply for the second motion.
3. In these circumstances, it would be appropriate that this quashing petition is taken up pursuant to completion of divorce proceedings and compliance of terms of settlement by the parties.

4. In view of the above, it is expected that the Ld. Trial Court will expeditiously dispose of the second motion of the divorce proceedings, prior to the next date before this Court, to achieve finality.

5. List on 12th April, 2023.
